incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: 华青智能助手 opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart 华青智能助手.

incompleteInstallation.title: 华青智能助手 installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest 华青智能助手. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionCore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest 华青智能助手 package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined 华青智能助手 components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: 华青智能助手 package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This 华青智能助手 package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: 华青智能助手 opened, but AionCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling 华青智能助手 may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: 华青智能助手 opened, but AionCore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling 华青智能助手 may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: 华青智能助手 opened, but AionCore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart 华青智能助手.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: 华青智能助手 detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, 华青智能助手 will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: 华青智能助手 is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another 华青智能助手 startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart 华青智能助手.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of AionUi is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of AionUi, and this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of AionUi newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: AionCore is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: AionCore couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: AionCore didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: AionCore failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry
